cdp_reason: Installed supported Chrome/CDP used for stable viewport matrix, explicit trusted touch/mouse events and Chrome manifest diagnostics; no dependencies installed or other browser profile reused. Native initial pointer worked after valid snapshot.

harness_events.event: First browser init refused existing SQLite file
harness_events.reason: Targeted/independent tests had generated their own private SQLite at the initially shared path. Init asserted missing file and stopped; new browser-http.sqlite was created instead; no application DB reset.

harness_events.event: First dropdown keyboard wait timed out
harness_events.reason: Full-page capture closed dropdown via layout/scroll. Viewport capture plus live open-state check then proved ArrowDown/Up/Escape/outside/scroll at all widths. Original first-run JSON retained.

harness_events.event: First preview upload timed out under APP_ENV=testing
harness_events.reason: Livewire FileUploadConfiguration uses per-request fake tmp-for-tests disk in testing mode. Preview server changed to local with same key/SQLite and debug=false; actual upload/preview passed at every width. Unit tests kept testing environment.

harness_events.event: Manifest JSON parser saw empty Chrome manifest
harness_events.classification: diagnostic handling plus actual product defect
harness_events.reason: Guest login has no manifest link. Follow-up diagnostic handles absence, records no-manifest, fetches file only for independent parse/icon/start-url checks; absence remains FAIL.

harness_events.event: Supplementary input hit sticky brand after scrollIntoView nearest
harness_events.reason: Input was obscured by fixed top bar; actual navigation went home. Corrected QA input helper to center target and assert elementFromPoint before touching. Missing value assertion and error capture retained; successful subset then completed.

harness_events.event: Two added PHPUnit cases reused browser-http SQLite via harness environment
harness_events.reason: RefreshDatabase cleared only task-owned private browser-http.sqlite after its HTTP/visual runs were complete. New empty browser-repeat.sqlite baseline was created for repeat/remaining diagnostics. No repair_app, repair_app_test, or MySQL QA race fixture affected. Runner now gives future PHPUnit processes :memory:.

harness_events.event: Manifest response list retained mutable navigation array
harness_events.reason: First diagnostic list included later role logins; original retained as manifest-first-diagnostics.json. Corrected array copy and repeated only manifest diagnostics; final immutable per-role lists stored.

harness_events.event: First manifest diagnostics used desktop UA with touch emulation
harness_events.reason: Retained desktop diagnostics; repeated only manifest under explicit Android UA/client hints/touch emulation. Physical Android remains NOT_RUN.
